touch_explainer.lay:
**FLY** (left): push to steer, push up to flap.
**DIVE** (right): tap to dive, drag to aim the dive.

crash.default: Pull up, you daft gull! Hold {flap}!
crash.realistic: Pull up, you daft gull! Tap {flap} fast!
crash.touch: Pull up, you daft gull! Push FLY up!

peck_now.casual: Auto peck is on. Fly into it!

live.missed: Missed! Pull up and dive again
live.first_miss: First miss is normal! Scoop it off the floor later
live.wheelie_low: Too low, gullster. Land on the lid.
live.bin_closer: Closer, gullster! Land right beside the bin.
live.mug_miss: Missed! Climb above him and dive straight through. No peck needed.
live.mug_rescue: He's holding still for you. Climb above him and dive straight through.

Steer with {steer}. Line up the snack.
Press {dive} to go.
aim_freeze.touch:
Steer with {steer}. Line up the snack.
Tap DIVE to go.

dive_nudge.touch: Climb above him, then tap DIVE

live.full_stomach: Finish your snack first, greedy guts.
live.practice: Pause, then level select, to progress

tips.wheelie_low: TOO LOW! LAND ON THE BIN LID
tips.bin_closer: CLOSER! LAND RIGHT BESIDE THE BIN

opening.text:
Welcome to the beach, young gullster.
If you want to survive 'n thrive, you got to learn quick. Follow the **golden ring**.

Might make a fine thief out of you yet.

closing.text: Not bad, gullster. Not bad at all. You can swoop, raid bins, bump rivals and mug them blind. Now get out there and fleece that beach.
closing.first_time_text:
Not bad, gullster. Not bad at all.

You can swoop, raid bins, bump rivals and mug them blind. Here's a feather for your trouble.

Now get out there and fleece that beach.

lay.default: This is the open sand. Nothing here worth nicking, so first things first: get airborne. Gulls fly by flapping and steering.
lay.realistic:
First things first: get airborne.

You picked Realistic mode, so every wingbeat is a separate tap.

how.default: Hold {flap} to flap and climb. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.
how.realistic: Tap {flap} over and over to climb, about four or five taps a second. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.
how.touch: Push FLY up to flap and climb. Steer with {steer} to head right. Fly through the golden ring.

strip.default: Hold {flap} to take off, then steer right
strip.realistic: Tap {flap} to take off, then steer right
strip.touch: Push FLY up to take off, then steer right

lessons.strip_steer: Steer right with {steer} to the ring

banner.default:
Hold {flap} to flap and climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.
banner.realistic:
Tap {flap} over and over to climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.
banner.touch:
Push FLY up to flap and climb.
Fly right through the golden ring.

lessons.banner_steer:
Now steer right with {steer}.
Fly through the golden ring.

lessons.lay: What goes up must come down, mate. Stop flapping and you glide, and gliding means sinking. Golden crumbs on the sand are free grub.

how.default: Let go of {flap}, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.
how.realistic: Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.
how.touch: Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land. Then walk over a golden crumb to eat it.

strip.default: Let go of {flap}, aim down and land
strip.realistic: Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land
strip.touch: Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land

banner.default:
Let go of {flap}, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.
banner.realistic:
Stop tapping {flap}, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.
banner.touch:
Stop pushing FLY up, aim down and land.
Then walk over a golden crumb.

lessons.lay:
Now let's get you a proper challenge.
See the fella with the ice cream? That's yours. Timing is everything...

how.default: Climb above your target. Press {dive} to dive and then tap {peck} right when your beak reaches the delicious target.
how.casual: Climb above him and press {dive} to dive. Casual mode does the pecking, so just fly your beak into the cone. Then aim up and climb away.
how.touch: Climb above your target. Tap DIVE to dive and then tap {peck} right when your beak reaches the delicious target.
how.touch_casual: Climb above him and tap DIVE to dive. Casual mode does the pecking, so just fly your beak into the cone. Then aim up and climb away.

strip.default: Aim at the snack, {dive} to dive, then tap {peck}
strip.casual: Dive with {dive}, your beak pecks for you
strip.touch: Aim at the snack, tap DIVE, then tap {peck}
strip.touch_casual: Tap DIVE, your beak pecks for you

lessons.lay: Bins are a proper buffet. Peck one open and everything inside spills onto the sand. Scraps are grub. Wrappers are rubbish, so leave them.
lessons.how: Land beside the bin and tap {peck} {n} times. Picnic bags burst the same way.
lessons.strip: Land by the bin and tap {peck} {n} times

lessons.lay: Time to meet the competition. This dummy is a rival gull, and he's nicked a snack. Mugging a rival is the best steal in the game. Careful though: rivals can mug you too.

how.default: Climb above him. Dive with {dive} and fly straight through him, no peck needed. The snack changes beaks. Full belly? Then you just bump him, and that counts too.
how.touch: Climb above him. Tap DIVE and fly straight through him, no peck needed. The snack changes beaks. Full belly? Then you just bump him, and that counts too.

strip.default: Dive with {dive} straight through the dummy
strip.touch: Tap DIVE straight through the dummy

closing.text:
That's the Gang Call, gullster. Fill the Brash meter, call the gang, nick the lot.

Anything you grabbed in training doesn't count, so make the real ones count. The clock starts now.

strips.default: Land on the ice cream sign
strips.realistic: Land on the ice cream sign, stop tapping {flap}
strips.touch: Land on the ice cream sign

strips: Hold {peck} to screech. Higher is louder
Brash is full! Screech again or press {call}
Grab the dropped food before they return

lessons.lay: Level two, gullster, and a new trick. A screech is a gull's best weapon, and it's louder from up high. That ice cream stand has a sign on its roof, and that's your stage.

how.default: Fly above the ice cream sign, let go of {flap} and drop onto it.
how.realistic: Fly above the ice cream sign, stop tapping {flap} and drop onto it.
how.touch: Fly above the ice cream sign, stop pushing FLY up and drop onto it.

lessons.lay: Screeching builds your Brash meter, the bar at the top of the screen. Bold moves fill it too: snatches, mugs and bumps. Get stunned and it drains, so stay cocky. The higher the perch, the faster it fills.
lessons.how: Hold {peck} to screech until the meter is full and says READY.

lessons.lay: Now for the best trick in the book: call the cavalry and see them runnin for cover!!
lessons.how: Screech again, or press {call}, to call the gang. Then grab the food they knock loose before the crowd comes back.

strips.default: Land on top of the ice cream stand
strips.realistic: Land on the ice cream stand, stop tapping {flap}
strips.touch: Land on top of the ice cream stand

strips: Wait for the yellow target, then dive

lessons.lay: One last lesson, gullster, and it's the big one: the perfect steal. Any gull can nick a snack off the sand. A true professional takes it straight off the counter.

how.default: Fly above the ice cream stand, let go of {flap} and drop onto the roof. Stay above the dogs.
how.realistic: Fly above the ice cream stand, stop tapping {flap} and drop onto the roof. Stay above the dogs.
how.touch: Fly above the ice cream stand, stop pushing FLY up and drop onto the roof. Stay above the dogs.

lessons.lay: Listen close. There's only a small window for a spotless theft. The moment the ice cream lands on the counter, that's your cue...

how.default: When the yellow target shows, aim at it, dive with {dive} and tap {peck} as your beak reaches the food.
how.casual: When the yellow target shows, aim at it and dive with {dive}. Your beak does the pecking.
how.touch: When the yellow target shows, aim at it, tap DIVE and tap {peck} as your beak reaches the food.
how.touch_casual: When the yellow target shows, aim at it and tap DIVE. Your beak does the pecking.
